intro.title: What is your property worth?
intro.text: Answer a few simple questions. Your price range appears as soon as you finish.

1.title: Let’s talk about your property
1.text: Apartment or house, and where is it?

2.title: Key details
2.text: A rough figure is fine if you are not sure.

3.title: Condition of the main elements
3.text: One rating per element. Not sure? Choose “?”.

4.title: The little extras
4.text: Garages, parking, cellar, outdoor space: they count too.

5.title: Your plans
5.text: This helps me get back to you at the right time.

6.title: Last step!
6.text: Check your summary, then tell me where to send the answer.

result.marketText: Price of comparable properties in your municipality
result.highText: With a buyer who falls in love with it
result.indicativeHouse: There are no public sale prices for houses in Luxembourg. This calculation starts from asking prices in your municipality, so the range is wider.
result.disclaimer: Indicative estimate based on public statistics. It does not replace an on-site valuation.
result.cta: Book an appointment for a precise valuation
result.noDataTitle: Thank you, your request has been sent
result.noDataText: There is not enough public data for your municipality. I will get back to you with a personalised valuation.
result.sent: Thank you, I have received your request.
result.sourceAppartement: Observatoire de l’Habitat (Ministry of Housing): notarial sale prices, asking prices and asking rents for apartments – data.public.lu, CC0 licence
result.sourceMaison: Observatoire de l’Habitat (Ministry of Housing): asking prices for houses – data.public.lu, CC0 licence
result.gaugeText: Price per m² of apartments sold from {debut} to {fin}, excluding the cheapest 5% and the most expensive 5%.
result.factorsNone: Your property matches the local average: no adjustment.
result.factorsCapped: To stay cautious, the total of the adjustments is capped.

appartement.high: Many recent sales in your municipality, and 3 methods that agree.
appartement.medium: There are real sales in your municipality, but fewer of them.
appartement.low: Few published sales in your municipality: the calculation relies on your canton.

maison.medium: Based on many house listings in your municipality.
maison.low: Few house listings in your municipality: treat this result with caution.

result.statCanton: Fewer than 10 published sales in your municipality: the median of the canton of {deCanton} is used.
result.howAppartement: Three methods are combined: actual sales registered with notaries, asking prices corrected for the usual gap between asking and sale price, and rental yield. Then your living area, condition, energy class and extras adjust the price.
result.howMaison: There are no public sale prices for houses. The calculation starts from the average asking price of houses in your municipality, corrected for the usual gap between asking and sale price. Then your living area, condition, energy class, plot and extras adjust the price.
result.next1: I receive your request and get back to you.
result.next2: On site, I refine the price with what figures can’t see: view, light, finishes, surroundings.
